Your blank workspace.

Choose Edit model to add framing components, change dimensions, or explore another floor.

Export your design to share it. This public template contains no customer drawings or source building data.

This editor uses generic component defaults and a 20 × 20 ft template for new floors. It does not read PDFs, calculate takeoffs, issue estimates or produce engineered framing.

Shape your concept.

Drag a library tile onto the model. Drag the component to move it. Resize uses L, H and D handles; Rotate changes its direction on the floor. Turn Snap off for continuous adjustments. Empty space or Orbit controls the camera. Export design saves a JSON file; import accepts files from this public editor only.
